'''Loreeves''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as a [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]] [[Merchant/Legends|vendor]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] she ran a stall within the Republic controlled [[Shipwright Auxiliary Spaceport]]. Loreeves had [[Color/Legends|brown]] hair, blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and fair skin. While at her stall she wore grey [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Loreeves first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' which was released in [[2011]] by [[BioWare]]. In the game she serves as a Republic stims vendor on Corellia. Her location was also marked on a map in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''; however, the guide provides her name as "Lora Preevus."
